# AzubaTrends

> Home & lifestyle products curated from trusted sellers, delivered
> across West Bengal.

AzubaTrends is a small ecommerce store selling home & lifestyle
products curated from trusted third-party sellers, with delivery
across West Bengal, India. AzubaTrends does not manufacture products
itself — it is a reselling business, and product listings reflect
what each seller actually offers. Each product page includes pricing,
available sizes/colors, and shipping details.

## Categories

Categories are managed dynamically and can be nested to any depth
(e.g. a top-level "Home Décor" category may contain "Terracotta", which
may itself contain more specific sub-categories). Because the catalog
changes over time, this file does not enumerate every category —
browse the full, always-current category tree here:

- Categories index: https://YOUR-DOMAIN/category

Each category page lists its own sub-categories (if any) and links
through to every product in that category and its sub-categories, so
crawling from the index above will reach the full catalog.

## Pages

- Home: https://YOUR-DOMAIN/
- Categories: https://YOUR-DOMAIN/category
- About: https://YOUR-DOMAIN/about.html
- Blog: https://YOUR-DOMAIN/blog.html
- Terms: https://YOUR-DOMAIN/terms.html

## Notes

- Products are not listed individually here since the catalog changes
  frequently and this is a static file — discover current products via
  the category pages linked above.
- This file is maintained by hand and updated only on major structural
  changes (e.g. new top-level categories). It is not regenerated
  automatically.
